newsitem.title: HUNGARY: WEAKENED DOLLAR DOMINATES HUNGARY FOREX FUTURES.
newsitem.headline: WEAKENED DOLLAR DOMINATES HUNGARY FOREX FUTURES.

text.p: The weakened dollar dominated Budapest's forex futures markets on Monday, accounting for almost 90 percent of modest turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) as prices fell for all maturites.
Most trades in the U.S. unit were for September, which fell 2.11 forints to 198.09, the principal beneficiary being the mark, which rose 0.85 to 109.95.
The December mark also rose, by 0.60 to 113.30 forints, while the dollar fell 2.62 for the same month to 204.13.
Total BCE turnover was 1.86 billion forints while that of the smaller Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) forex futures market was 1.06 billion forints.
On the BSE, the mark rose 0.42 to 112.88 forints for December but was unchanged for all other maturites, with September remaining at 108.15.

The dollar fell by between one and three forints for all maturities and saw trades for this August, which fell 2.65 to 198.50, and December, which fell 2.28 to 206.21. The untraded September dollar fell 2.00 forints to 200.80.
